Testing the first t with F^(t+2)(x)=F^t(x) for every labelled x, then binning by the smaller of the two cyclic phases, reproduced the entry histogram (5184,15552,22528,22272) and all nine basin rows, including both fixed consensus basins and the alternating-shore 9522 basin. Separate restrictions of the same independently built map to inputs supported on each shore reproduced image sizes 136,88,72, stabilization and the paired fiber weights 1/2/69 with multiplicities 22/48/2; the weight-69 targets are exactly the two constant words. The swap on the recurrent product follows from g and h restricting to inverse bijections. Fibers of F^4 factor; grouping the diagonal or two off-diagonal product fibers gives the stated individual basins. Replay: python3 /workspace/audit_evidence/majority.py. No assertion extends to other graphs or update rules.
